text:
alex_sales: Hey team — HealthCo (enterprise healthcare) is asking for an on‑prem POC next week. They want: SOC2 artifacts, a pen‑test letter, and staged creds so their infosec can run tests. Also asked whether POC will incur Dedicated pricing. Need quick plan + owners.

rachel_se: thanks alex. main questions: 1) do they need full dedicated GPU pool for the POC or will a temporary private staging suffice? 2) network requirements (IPs, egress rules). 3) timeline for evidence (we usually can bundle SOC2 summary + artifact extracts within 2 business days).

mira_security: tagging in: we can provide SOC2 summary + control matrix extract, and a redacted set of ISO docs. For the pen‑test letter we have a standard attestation template — is HealthCo expecting us to sign a letter saying we performed a test on our infra, or do they expect a pen test of the customer‑facing POC environment?

alex_sales: they said "their security team will run scans against the POC endpoint in their environment" — so likely they want a pen‑test attestation and permission/assurance for them to run tests. also asked whether the POC would show up as Dedicated usage for billing.

tyler_devops: we can stand up a private staging cluster in the customer's VPC (or our VPC with IP allowlist). Provisioning steps: 
```
# example flow
1) create private deployment (redwood private)
2) configure network peering / whitelisted IPs
3) create ephemeral API key + timebox 72h
```
If they want it in their VPC, we need network details and an infra ticket. For billing: short POC (<14 days) can be on a trial instance without reserved commit; longer/reserved becomes Dedicated pricing. cc @jordan_sales for pricing nuance.

jordan_sales: pricing clarify — typical POC we keep on hosted/dedicated burst to avoid commit. If they request single‑tenant VPC for the POC we may need a small reserved pool (monthly) — i can give a scoped quote once infra needs are clear. Also note extra day rate for staged SFTP evidence upload/testing if we assist them.

mira_security: For scanning permission we need: (a) scope of scans (ports/URIs), (b) scheduled window, (c) list of IPs from their scanner. Provide pen‑test permission template -> we issue signed letter that says we authorize HealthCo to scan X Y Z endpoints on dates. We do not sign for scans that target our production multi‑tenant infra.

rachel_se: action items: 
- alex to get HealthCo technical contact + desired window (alex_sales)
- HealthCo to send scanner IPs + scan scope (HealthCo)
- security to prepare pen‑test permission + SOC2 extract (mira_security)
- infra to queue staging provisioning + ephemeral creds (tyler_devops)
- pricing quote if VPC/dedicated requested (jordan_sales)

alex_sales: pinged customer — they want next Tue/Wed window. Contact is fred.kim@healthco.com, security lead "Fred Kim". I copied the schedule in thread and asked for scanner IPs and their SSO requirements.

upload-bot: Note: Please upload evidence zips to secure sftp at sftp.redwood-internal.com/proofs/healthco. Pre-signed URL will expire in 48h.

mira_security: i put together the pen‑test permission draft, attaching snippet here (will upload full letter to evidence zip):
```
Redwood Inference declares permission for HealthCo security team to perform non‑destructive vulnerability scans against the provisioned POC endpoints: /api/v1/* and streaming endpoints. Scans must be scheduled between 2024-11-05 and 2024-11-07, limited to listed IPs. Redwood will provide ephemeral creds and access logs for review.
```

rachel_se: good. one more ask from procurement — customer asked if we can include a short statement in the evidence bundle about data residency for the POC (which is ephemeral). Mira: can you include a short paragraph clarifying no PHI is stored in logs and retention window for POC traces?

mira_security: yes — i'll include a redacted residency statement and retention note (logs kept 72h unless requested otherwise).

tyler_devops: final infra note: to expedite, please share the CIDR/IPs asap. I can provision ephemeral host + key within 24h of receiving IPs. If they want full VPC peering that'll add ~3–5 business days.

jordan_sales: i'll draft a 7‑day POC quote for hosted/private options and a short note on billing impact. will post by EOD.

alex_sales: perfect. i'll follow up with fred for the IPs and SSO details. tagging everyone — pls ack when ready so i can schedule the test window. :thumbsup:

rachel_se: ack.

mira_security: ack, will upload artifacts to sftp once draft is signed.

tyler_devops: ack, ready on infra side.

jordan_sales: ack, quote incoming.
